ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters limited to distal margins; macro-ratio estimated at 95% low-intensity to 5% high-intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across >90% of the visible surface; localized circular low-contrast grey mottling present on the inner-mid section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped vertex with an approximate 45-degree internal angle and shallow vertical penetration relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregularities; significant macro-notches and deep indentations on the right lobe trailing edge; finer-scale serration along the left lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory originating from the median notch and tapering to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast white geometric shapes (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; secondary white punctate spots scattered across the central fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jagged tissue loss/notching on the trailing edge of the right lobe consistent with physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive peripheral acorn barnacle colonization concentrated on distal fluke margins.
